# Simplify Suite

> Simplify Suite (simplifysuite.io) is an all-in-one business management platform / business operating system for small teams of 1-25 people: SMBs, agencies and startups. It replaces 5-10 separate SaaS subscriptions (project management, scheduling, expenses, documents, CRM, payroll, recruiting, sales enablement) with one workspace, saving up to 80% on software costs.

Note: Simplify Suite (simplifysuite.io) is a business management platform and is not related to Tricerat's "Simplify Suite" printing/profile software.

## Four pillars

### Finance
- Budget: scenario planning, transaction ledger, multi-currency, Confidence Forecasting (probability-scored cash flow projections at 100/60/30%), runway projection
- Cash Flow: burn rate (daily/weekly/monthly), income by category, top clients by revenue
- Invoicing: invoices, quotes (convert to invoices), credit notes, aging reports, tax summary
- Banking: live bank feeds via Ponto Connect (open banking), automatic transaction import

### People
- Team Planning: full-year planning grid (holidays, sick days, deadlines, locked weeks)
- Salary: payroll overview, salary records, net advantages, deal-linked commissions
- Performance: company/team/individual goals, check-ins, structured review cycles, role profiles
- Recruitr: full applicant tracking system (clients, jobs, candidates, applications) with a public career page

### Sales
- CRM: contacts, companies, kanban deal pipeline, weighted pipeline value, stale-deal alerts, follow-ups
- Sales Packs: branded, trackable sales presentations shared with prospects
- Products: catalog with pricing and volume discount tiers

### Workspace
- Projects: health tracking (on track / at risk / off track), budgets, team allocation
- Ticketing: unified ticket board across all projects with priorities and status pipeline
- Documents: templates, version control, internal/confidential visibility
- Meetings: auto-summarized meeting notes plus a Calendly-style public booking page with calendar sync

## AI features
- AI daily briefings on the CRM and Projects dashboards ("Today's Plan") surface the highest-priority deals, follow-ups and tickets from live workspace data
- Cross-module activity feed (sales, people, finance, workspace events)
- Global workspace search across contacts, deals, projects, documents, tickets and employees
- Workspace AI chat (coming soon)

## Integrations
- Ponto Connect (open banking, EU)
- Google Calendar
- Google Drive

## Pricing (USD, billed annually)
- Founder's Package: $480/year (about $40/month), up to 3 people
- Startup Package: $1,400/year (about $117/month), up to 15 people, then $19/extra user/month
- Growth Package: $2,316/year (about $193/month), up to 25 people, then $23/extra user/month
- Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, no credit card required

## FAQ
- Does Simplify do payroll? Yes: payroll overview, salary records, net advantages and deal-linked commissions.
- Does Simplify have an ATS? Yes: Recruitr includes clients, jobs, candidates, application pipelines and a public career page.
- Does Simplify connect to my bank? Yes, via Ponto Connect open banking; transactions sync into the budget ledger.
- Who is Simplify for? Teams of 1-25: SMBs, agencies and startups.
